description:
Second step of bd:JMAP-510h.14. The canonical sibling jmap-mail-server uses a FaultyBackend wrapper in tests/common/mod.rs for fault injection — see crate-jmap-mail-server/tests/common/mod.rs:33-66.

Replicate that pattern in filenode-server: a thin wrapper around MemoryBackend that injects errors on demand for specific (type_name, op) pairs. Cover the four fault knobs currently on MockBackend:
- get_ancestors_err
- blob_exists_err
- query_objects_err
- create_object_override_name (override the created object's name field)

For src/filenode.rs unit tests (which can't import from tests/), put the wrapper inside the 'mod tests' block as private test scaffolding.

After this bead: the remaining ~8 fault-injecting unit tests can be migrated by swapping MockBackend for FaultyBackend.
title: filenode-server: add FaultyBackend wrapper for fault-injection unit tests (canonical mail-server pattern)
